verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs explicitly state that low-risk integrations (Checkout, Elements, hosted payment pages) collect and transmit payment data directly to Stripe without it passing through the developer's servers, explicitly reducing PCI obligations/scope, and these are backed by concrete hosted/embeddable products (Checkout, Payment Links, Elements). missing for 10: independent third-party PCI audit or compliance-report corroboration beyond Stripe's own docs.
